about.title: A competitive Pokémon TCG site built around the decks.
about.description: Prize Map is written by a competitive player for players getting ready for their next event. Most posts are deck builds. The rest cover what changes the format: new sets, rotation, and the Regionals and Cups coming up.

principles.title: Every build is complete.
principles.description: Each deck post has the full 60, the strategy, the play patterns, the matchups it wins and the decks that beat it.

principles.title: Every claim is dated.
principles.description: Posts carry the newest legal set when they were written, and older builds are flagged when a new set lands.

principles.title: Every post ends with a decision.
principles.description: What to register, what to test, or what to cut. A verdict you can act on before the next round.
